title: Payment Registration and Bank Reconciliation Full Workflow
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business

new_function_ids.description: Wizard _create_payment_vals_from_wizard: builds payment dict including destination_account_id from invoice line
account.payment model: state (draft/in_process/paid/canceled/rejected), move_id link, outstanding_account_id, destination_account_id
account.payment.method.line: links payment method to journal; payment_account_id determines outstanding/in-transit account
account.bank.statement: still exists in Odoo 19 Community; groups statement lines with balance_start/end
account.bank.statement.line: _inherits account.move; move is auto-posted on create; payment_ids tracks auto-generated payments
Suspense account: journal.suspense_account_id; initial counterpart for unreconciled bank statement lines
_prepare_move_line_default_vals on statement line: creates liquidity line (bank account) + suspense line
action_undo_reconciliation: remove_move_reconcile + unlink auto-generated payments + reset to default lines
_compute_payment_state on account.move: SQL-based computation of not_paid/partial/paid/reversed states
Payment is_matched: True when liquidity lines residual is zero (bank statement reconciled against outstanding account)
Payment journal entry structure: liquidity line on outstanding_account_id, counterpart on destination_account_id
account.move.line.reconcile() → _reconcile_plan([self]): standard entry point confirmed (from U79)
_reconcile_payments: iterates per account, combining payment counterpart lines + invoice lines, calls reconcile()
_get_default_amls_matching_domain: domain for bank reconciliation matching candidates
_synchronize_to_moves: keeps statement line fields in sync with underlying journal entry on write

key_findings: account_bank_statement_import module does NOT exist in Odoo 19 Community addons — import is in-module
account.payment.state has 5 values: draft, in_process, paid, canceled, rejected (no 'posted')
account.payment.action_post() sets state to 'in_process' (bank) or 'paid' (cash) — not 'posted'
Community: _get_invoice_in_payment_state() always returns 'paid' — no in_payment invoice state in Community
Bank statement line uses _inherits on account.move — is a delegation-inherited journal entry
Suspense account = journal.suspense_account_id; initial counterpart line on all unreconciled statement lines
Bank statement matching clears suspense line → replaces with outstanding account line → reconcile() → payment.is_matched=True → payment.state='paid'
Invoice payment_state computed via SQL using account_partial_reconcile + all_payments_matched boolean aggregate
